newsitem.title: USA: Evolutions apparel units file Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Evolutions apparel units file Chapter 11.

text.p: Evolutions Inc said Monday its apparel units have filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and the company does not have sufficient capital to support its remaining operations.
The company said a secured lender to the apparel units foreclosed "on substantially all" of the units' assets.
In a written statement, company president Michael Nafash said the company has not been able to raise additional financing to support remaining operations.

Preliminary results for Evolutions fiscal 1996 show a loss of more than $5 million on sales of more than $21 million, the company said. Nearly all sales were derived from discontinued operations, it said.
